title: Chapter 1323 - 8: Lin Yuan’S Rapid Progress
content:
Chapter 1323 - 8: Lin Yuan’S Rapid Progress

Chapter 1323: Chapter 8: Lin Yuan’s Rapid Progress

Since the Yin Yang Twin Flowers are useful to Lin Yuan, it’s natural to take the Ice Mountain and Volcano that nurtured them as well.

After all, for Lin Yuan, it’s just a matter of lifting a finger.

In this region, Yin Yang Power converges, so even if the Ice Mountain and Volcano are taken away.

Over countless years, new Ice Mountain and Volcano will be born again.

And between the Ice Mountain and Volcano, the Yin Yang Twin Flowers will also regrow.

"It’s time to return."

Putting the Ice Mountain and Volcano into his internal universe, Lin Yuan turned and headed back to the Chaos Void.

The Dimensional Gap is filled with too many variables and uncontrollable factors.

Lin Yuan has not truly stepped into the thirteenth level, even though there’s no difference with normal time lives.

It’s still best to minimize the stay.

If it weren’t for the Yin Yang Twin Holy Flowers being of great help to improve his Chaotic Taiji Dao.

Lin Yuan wouldn’t have specifically sent the Taiji Primordial Spirit here.

As for the many gains along the way and the Nightmare Fruits?

They are not absolutely necessary.

...

Compared to the decades spent traveling from the Chaos Void to the region of Ice Mountain and Volcano.

The return to the Chaos Void takes much less time.

"Yin Yang Twin Flowers."

Lin Yuan carefully observed the extraordinary flower that had already fully bloomed at the intersection of the Ice Mountain and Volcano.

A delicate aura of Yin and Yang intertwining and coexisting permeated the air.

"God, great God."

Atop the Ice Mountain and Volcano, countless supreme Yin beings and supreme Yang beings worshiped Lin Yuan with devotion.

In their eyes, Lin Yuan was an unspeakably great existence who, with just a stretch of his right hand, took away the homeland they’ve lived in for countless ages, along with themselves.

Such an existence, a mere breath could likely extinguish all supreme Yang beings and supreme Yin beings.

They could not help but revere him.

"Continue with your lives."

Lin Yuan did not make it difficult for these supreme Yin beings and supreme Yang beings.

He even planned to create a dedicated area for these dimensional beings to thrive within his internal universe.

Lin Yuan was quite curious about what kind of life would be born when the supreme Yin and supreme Yang beings combined.

...

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding is extraordinary, observing the mysterious miraculous flower, greatly enhancing your comprehension of the Chaotic Taiji Dao...]

Just by slightly observing and understanding the Yin Yang Twin Flowers, Lin Yuan felt countless inspirations arise in his Chaotic Taiji Dao.

The powers of Taiyin and Taiyang swirled around Lin Yuan, sometimes forming a Taichi Diagram that suppresses all, sometimes forming a Taiji Sword that destroys everything, sometimes forming...

"Yin Yang? Taiji?"

Lin Yuan was in high spirits, rapidly absorbing the insights bubbling up in his mind, while continuing to observe the Yin Yang Twin Flowers.

Even the two Ice Mountains and Volcanoes were included in Lin Yuan’s range of observation and understanding.

"According to a normal timeline, I would need at least tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years to elevate the Chaotic Taiji Dao to the third layer before the thirteenth level."

Lin Yuan thought swiftly in his heart, "But now? A few thousand years will be enough."

The guidance effect of the Yin Yang Twin Flowers on Lin Yuan was too strong, this was a Tao Fruit nurtured by the mysterious Dimensional Gap, representing the fusion and coexistence of Yin and Yang.

Combined with Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, the combination was more than just one plus one being greater than two.

This was a qualitative change!

"The third layer of the Chaotic Taiji Dao, that’s truly the ultimate before the thirteenth level of my path, it’s the limit of the path, not the limit of Secret Techniques."

Lin Yuan pondered in his heart.

For example, opening up an infinite Constant Sand Particle World within his body, that would belong to Secret Techniques.

It required Lin Yuan to spend time developing it, but the Chaotic Taiji Dao? That’s the path Lin Yuan was on.

This was truly something that belonged to Lin Yuan, even if his consciousness traversed and descended, it could be utilized anytime, without other limitations.

...

Galactic Chaos Continent.

Although Lin Yuan developed thirty-three Postnatal Universes, some of the elite from the human civilization had already moved to the thirty-three Postnatal Universes.

Yet, the Galactic Chaos Continent still remained the undisputed stronghold of human civilization, the thirty-three Postnatal Universes were the foundation of human civilization, ensuring its endless legacy.

On this day.

Dozens of twelfth-level evolvers from human civilization gathered together, discussing matters.

Swoosh~ a figure descended, it was Lin Yuan.

The dozens of twelfth-level evolvers of human civilization’s hearts raced, immediately saluting respectfully.

Other than the nine supreme beings who initially left their home universe with Lin Yuan, the other twelfth-level evolvers barely ever had the chance to meet Lin Yuan.

For this Invincible Great Saint who swept through the Chaos Void with no equal in his era, they naturally held great reverence.

"Galaxy." The Xuanyuan Supreme greeted.

"I’m here to supplement some rare treasures for the tribe’s treasury." Lin Yuan said with a small smile.

After the Taiji Primordial Spirit returned, Lin Yuan gathered all the scraps he couldn’t use, planning to pack them up and send them to the Human Civilization Treasury.

As the towering pillar of human civilization’s race, Lin Yuan naturally doesn’t mind giving back to his people.

Back in the native universe, didn’t the Human Civilization Treasury collect many Twelfth Layer rare treasures as a result of the nine Supremes’ contributions?

With the strength of the nine Supremes at the time, these rare treasures were akin to being completely gifted to future generations, without any expectation of return.

"Supplement the exchange of rare treasures?"

Xia Qin Supreme and Void God Ultimate Being exchanged glances and spoke softly, "Galaxy, the help you’ve provided to our race has been immense. Don’t let it interfere with your own cultivation..."

Opening up the Galaxy’s Chaos Continent, protecting the human civilization race.

Later, he opened thirty-three Postnatal Universes, laying the immortal foundation for human civilization.

Such assistance left Xia Qin Supreme and the other nine Supremes unsure of how to repay him, and now he’s come to supplement the exchange of rare treasures again?

"It’s no matter, these rare treasures don’t mean much to me."

Lin Yuan glanced at the other respectful Twelfth Layer evolvers, "You can also take a look, and if you need something, just use your merits to exchange for it."

As soon as he finished speaking,

Lin Yuan waved his hand.

Suddenly, a large number of ’items’ fell down.

In addition to some regular rare treasures, there were many ’corpses.’

They were all ’corpses’ of beings from the dimension rift.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit had wandered the dimension rift for so long and occasionally acted against the beings there.

These beings were incredibly weak to Lin Yuan, but naturally extremely powerful in the eyes of the numerous evolvers of human civilization.

Back in the native universe, human civilization once obtained the corpse of a Twelfth Layer life form drifting in from a cosmic gap, which triggered a fierce battle among the Supremes.

Ultimately, human civilization obtained a piece of the corpse for the next generation of talented evolvers to comprehend.

Lin Yuan also gained a lot from that piece of the corpse.

The corpse of a powerful life form contained the path it had taken.

Compared to directly sensing the rules of the great Dao, sensing the physical structure of a powerful life form is somewhat easier.

"These corpses?"

Xia Qin Supreme, Xuanyuan Supreme, and the other nine Supremes, along with many other Twelfth Layer evolvers, felt tremendous pressure.

Each of the thousands of corpses Lin Yuan casually tossed out brought them significant pressure.

"These corpses... are all dimension life form corpses, containing some rather good pathways. I’ve kept them specifically for the evolutionists of our race to study."

Lin Yuan said casually.

The paths taken by lives that survived in the dimension rift were mostly extreme, pursuing the ultimate in power.

But extremity also has its benefits; ultimately, it’s up to the race’s evolvers to make their own choices.

"What was the strength of this corpse when it was alive?" Feather Butterfly Supreme looked at a corpse resembling an octopus, its aura seemingly illusory, faintly forming a miniature world.

"Probably a bit stronger than the Invincible Great Saint, but considered weak among this group of ’corpses’."

Lin Yuan replied.

"Stronger than the Invincible Great Saint?" Xuanyuan Supreme was stunned.

The other few Supremes looked again at the remaining thousands of corpses, thinking that according to Lin Yuan’s implication, if the octopus corpse was considered weak, then were these corpses all stronger than the Invincible Great Saint when alive?

Thousands of lives stronger than the Invincible Great Saint, all killed by Lin Yuan and sent here?

Xuanyuan Supreme and the other nine Supremes took a deep breath. Even though they had watched Lin Yuan grow, understanding his terrifying growth speed,

They still found it inconceivable to see thousands of corpses, each stronger than the Invincible Great Saint, placed right in front of them.

"These..."

While the nine Supremes were shocked, they were somewhat prepared, as any unimaginable occurrence related to Lin Yuan could be rapidly accepted by them.

The scores of newly born Twelfth Layer evolvers from human civilization, however, were in complete mental disarray.

Dimension rift life forms stronger than the Invincible Great Saint?

Since when could Invincible Great Saints appear in groups?

Isn’t the Galaxy Great Saint also an Invincible Great Saint?

"Alright, these rare treasure corpses, feel free to comprehend them; I’ve removed all the chaotic killing intent inside."

Lin Yuan instructed a few more words, and his figure disappeared again.

Leaving behind a group of dumbfounded human civilization Supremes and Twelfth Layer evolvers staring at the numerous rare treasure corpses.

...

Soon.

The news that the Human Civilization Treasury had received a batch of dimension rift rare treasures quickly spread.

"So many rift rare treasures? Many of the rift corpses are stronger than the Invincible Great Saint? Invincible Great Saint corpses? So many?"

Many human civilization evolvers, looking at the Treasury exchange list, were shocked beyond composure.

"Isn’t it said that the dimension rift is perilous, and even peerless Great Saints dare not explore deeply? Where did these rift rare treasure corpses come from?"

"Stop the wild speculations; it’s what the great Galaxy Great Saint bestowed upon us. It is said Galaxy Great Saint explored the dimension rift once, casually collected these treasures, and then selected some to be bestowed to nurture future generations."

Some well-informed evolvers said.

Lin Yuan is now undoubtedly the spiritual pillar of human civilization, having elevated human civilization to the pinnacle of power within the Chaos Void.

"What strength does the Galaxy Great Saint possess now? Has he stepped into the Thirteenth Layer? Why does the dimension rift, full of dangers, seem like nothing to the Galaxy Great Saint, as if it’s his backyard garden?"

"How did human civilization ever give birth to such a being as the Galaxy Great Saint?" Many older-generation evolvers, who once left the native universe, wept with emotion.

They understood the overwhelming pressure they faced from other races when in the native universe.

But ever since the rise of the Galaxy Great Saint, pressure? The only pressure for human civilization is that the Galaxy Great Saint grows so fast that they can’t keep up.
